(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: IDF striking in Lebanon after soldiers intercepted a drone launched by Hezbollah terrorists
item.description:
Earlier on Friday, terrorists from the Hezbollah terrorist organization launched a drone towards IDF soldiers operating in the Security Zone in southern Lebanon, the IDF Spokesperson's Unit said.
According to the statement, IDF soldiers opened fire and downed the drone. No IDF injuries were reported. "The IDF is currently operating and will continue to act with determination against Hezbollah’s repeated attempts to harm IDF soldiers," said the IDF.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: Shabbat Shalom from Israel!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' Israel desk is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of Shabbat. Jerusalem candle lighting time is 18:20 on Friday. Our North American desk will keep you informed until the 19:05 EDT candle lighting time in New York.
The updates from Israel will resume Saturday night, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 19:35 in Jerusalem.
Shabbat Shalom!

item.title: Gilad Erdan: Unity Party pulls out of upcoming elections
item.description: Gilad Erdan announces that the Unity Party he founded will not compete in the upcoming elections, acknowledging that the party is unlikely to clear the electoral threshold.

item.title: Political drama: Erdan withdraws from race
item.description:
Gilad Erdan announced that the Unity Party he founded will not run in the upcoming elections.
According to Erdan, the party's current level of support does not make it highly likely to cross the electoral threshold, while efforts to join forces with additional parties have also failed to materialize.

item.title: Locked out of WhatsApp: Users suddenly lose access with no warning
item.description: WhatsApp users locked out without warning as account bans spark growing backlash.

item.title: China: Death toll in Tibet floods rises to 31
item.description: The death toll on the Chinese side of the Nepal-Tibet border has risen to 31, while nine days after the disaster, 531 people are still listed as missing.

item.title: Fear in Paris hotel: Elderly Israeli woman attacked in her sleep
item.description: An elderly Israeli woman was violently attacked, suffering multiple facial fractures, in her Paris hotel room in Paris. Her family heard her screams, overpowered the suspect, and alerted police.

item.title: IAI’s cargo giant takes to the skies in major milestone
item.description: IAI’s massive Airbus A330-300 freighter completes its maiden flight, bringing the groundbreaking cargo conversion one step closer to certification and commercial service.

item.title: Ha'achdut officials: Blue and White refused to pursue unity
item.description: Officials in Gilad Erdan's 'Ha'achdut' party accuse Blue and White of seeking media attention rather than genuine unity.

item.title: PM praises soldiers for successful Samaria weapons raid
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu commented, "I commend our forces on a successful operation in Samaria in which they destroyed dozens of lathes for weapons manufacturing, seized dozens of weapons, and arrested individuals wanted for involvement in terrorism." "​Our activity to thwart terrorism continues with full force in Judea and Samaria, Gaza, Lebanon, and every place where our enemies attempt to threaten the State of Israel."
